articles.title: Lonza (SWX:LONN) Stock Could Be 15% Overvalued On Its US CDMO Deal
articles.summary: Lonza Group has delivered a strong share-price run in recent years, and fresh deal activity is adding a new layer to the story. The question now is whether the current valuation can be supported by the cash flows that Lonza is expected to generate. Over the past 3 years Lonza Group has returned 103.3%, which puts a lot of recent optimism on the line when you compare that performance with what its cash flows can justify.
